WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
driver_wins AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.XCL_079 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_career_wins
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_079 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
           AVG(
               (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
               + CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') - INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL)
               + CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
           ) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 AS forename,
       d.XCL_039 AS surname,
       d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
       COALESCE(dw.total_career_wins, 0) AS total_career_wins,
       dfl.avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM drivers d
JOIN eligible_drivers ed ON d.XCL_034 = ed.driver_id
LEFT JOIN driver_wins dw ON d.XCL_034 = dw.driver_id
JOIN driver_fastest_laps dfl ON d.XCL_034 = dfl.driver_id
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1
